properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.access-key
properties.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.amazon-mq-client
properties.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.mq.MqClient. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired. The option is a software.amazon.awssdk.services.mq.MqClient type.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.configuration
properties.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.aws2.mq.MQ2Configuration type.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the aws2-mq component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.health-check-consumer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.health-check-producer-enabled
properties.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.operation
properties.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsMQOperation header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.override-endpoint
properties.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.pojo-request
properties.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a CreateBrokerRequest, which the producer sends as it is. The headers that give the input of the operation are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.profile-credentials-name
properties.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.proxy-host
properties.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon MQ connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.proxy-port
properties.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP client of Amazon MQ connects through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.proxy-protocol
properties.description: The protocol that the HTTP client of Amazon MQ uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.region
properties.description: The AWS region of Amazon MQ, as a region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.secret-key
properties.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.session-token
properties.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.trust-all-certificates
properties.description: Whether the HTTP client of Amazon MQ trusts every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.uri-endpoint-override
properties.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.use-default-credentials-provider
properties.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.use-profile-credentials-provider
properties.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

properties.name: camel.component.aws2-mq.use-session-credentials
properties.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.
